The tracklist for JADE's debut solo album, That's Showbiz Baby!, comprises 14 tracks on the standard release, with 8 bonus tracks added for the deluxe edition, That's Showbiz Baby! The Encore.[1][2]

 Standard Edition Tracklist

 1. "Angel of My Dreams"[2]
 2. "It Girl"[2]
 3. "FUFN (Fuck You for Now)"[2]
 4. "Plastic Box"[2]
 5. "Midnight Cowboy"[2]
 6. "Fantasy"[2]
 7. "Unconditional"[2]
 8. "Self Saboteur"[2]
 9. "Lip Service"[2]
 10. "Headache"[2]
 11. "Natural at Disaster"[2]
 12. "Glitch"[2]
 13. "Before You Break My Heart"[2]
 14. "Silent Disco"[2]

 The Encore Bonus Tracks

The extended edition includes eight additional songs:

 15. "Church"[1][2]
 16. "This Is What We Dance For"[1][2]
 17. "Dreamcheater"[1][2]
 18. "Best You Could"[1][2]
 19. "Use Me"[1][2]
 20. "Frozen"[1][2]
 21. "If My Heart Was a House"[1][2]
 22. "Tar"[1][2]
